Type: square X-frame coffee table
Use: holding drinks, books and decor in front of a sofa; living room
Style: industrial, farmhouse, rustic
Materials: pine plank top, bronze-toned metal frame
Colors: light greyish natural wood, dark bronze
Shape: low square, thin metal frame with X-braces on each side, plank top inset in a metal edge, open and airy, medium size
Feel: casual, airy, rugged
Goes with: linen sofas, weathered wood, neutral walls, black or bronze accents; farmhouse or industrial living rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Roland X-Frame Coffee Table, 36"W, Pine
product.description: 36"L x 36"W x 18"H Solid pine top with metal frame Industrial, rustic and modern touches come together in a piece that blends with most décor This sturdy piece will last through years of family movie nights and entertaining guests Easy assembly in 15-30 minutes. Wipe with soft dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty. This wood and metal coffee table combines elements of industrial and rustic, allowing it to blend with many styles. The solid pine wood top has a natural distressed finish, while the metal base has modern "x" frames on either end.
